value.name: au-govt-abs-abs-regional-population-age-sex-lga-2020-lga2020
value.notes:
This dataset presents the preliminary estimates of the resident population by age and sex as at 30 June 2020. The data is aggregated to the 2020 edition of the Local Government Areas (LGA).
This data is ABS data available from the Australian Bureau of Statistics.
For more information please refer to the Methodology.
Estimated resident population (ERP) is the official estimate of the Australian population, which links people to a place of usual residence within Australia. Usual residence within Australia refers to that address at which the person has lived or intends to live for six months or more in a given reference year. For the 30 June reference date, this refers to the calendar year around it. Estimates of the resident population are based on Census counts by place of usual residence (excluding short-term overseas visitors in Australia), with an allowance for Census net undercount, to which are added the estimated number of Australian residents temporarily overseas at the time of the Census. A person is regarded as a usual resident if they have been (or expected to be) residing in Australia for a period of 12 months or more over a 16-month period.

post.description:
Start here to find datasets and their resource ids. Use `organization` with a slug from list_organizations (ABS Census tables: `government-of-the-commonwealth-of-australia-australian-bureau-of-statistics-australian-urban-researc`; ABS: `australianbureauofstatistics`). Add `fq: "res_datastore_active:true"` to keep only datasets whose rows query_datastore can read.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: Result offset to resume from: the `next_cursor` of the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

ext_bbox.description: Bounding box `minx,miny,maxx,maxy` (WGS84 lon/lat); keeps datasets whose spatial extent intersects it. Pattern: ^-?[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]+)?,-?[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]+)?,-?[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]+)?,-?[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]+)?$.

fq.description: Raw Solr filter query ANDed with the filters above, e.g. `res_datastore_active:true` or `metadata_modified:[2025-01-01T00:00:00Z TO *]`.

organization.description: Organisation slug, e.g. `australianbureauofstatistics` (from list_organizations or facets.organization[].name). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$.

q.description: Full-text query (Solr syntax allowed: quotes, AND/OR, field:value). Omit to list everything.

res_format.description: Resource format a dataset must offer, e.g. `CSV`, `XLSX`, `WMS`.

rows.description:
Datasets per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 20.

sort.description: Solr sort, e.g. `metadata_modified desc`, `title_string asc`. Default `score desc, metadata_modified desc`. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z_]+ (asc|desc)(, [A-Za-z_]+ (asc|desc))*$.

tags.description: Tags that must all be present. Case-sensitive (`Census` and `census` are different tags).

Returns dataset cards with their resources (ids, formats, download URLs, `datastore_active`) and the top facet values for the query. Harvested records from state portals and AURIN are included; `harvest_source` says where a record came from.

The response contains the tool result directly.
